title: Mirror / Vector Multi-Projection and Dimensional-Collapse Model
status: primary project relational scaffold + developed multi-view representation theory; not literal planetary dimensional physics
abstract: The Mirror/Vector model recovers a project requirement that one underlying object may be described simultaneously through multiple paired views—inner/outer, macro/micro, horizontal/vertical, source/manifestation, observer/container—without declaring those views numerically identical. Its strongest mathematical formulation is a typed multi-view representation problem. A latent state X lives in a structured state space S; each descriptive domain k has a projection pi_k:S->Y_k; translation between two views is a learned or defined map T_jk:Y_j->Y_k; reconstruction attempts infer X from one or more views. The key scientific questions are information loss, sufficiency, consistency and invariants: what does each projection preserve, which variables are unrecoverable, whether two routes through the representation diagram agree, and whether an invariant can be defined without conflating its physical meanings. The old 'dimensional collapse' sequence is therefore interpreted primarily as description/compression depth unless a separate physical spacetime model is explicitly invoked. This redevelopment adds information-theoretic loss, commutative-diagram errors, cross-view prediction and a model-selection contract, making Mirror a genuine representation/reconstruction theory rather than a list of analogies.
research_question: Can multiple project views be represented as typed projections of a latent state such that information loss, cross-view prediction, reconstruction error and invariant preservation can be measured without confusing symbolic equivalence with physical identity?

typed_latent_model.latent_space: X in S with explicitly typed coordinates and domain constraints
typed_latent_model.rule: Coordinates from different semantic/physical types cannot be numerically equated without an explicit map and units/meaning contract.

projection_information.data_processing: If X->Y_j->Y_k is a Markov chain, I(X;Y_k)<=I(X;Y_j)
projection_information.task_sufficiency: Y_k is sufficient for target Z when I(Z;X|Y_k)=0 under the selected probabilistic model
projection_information.interpretation: A lower-dimensional description can be perfectly sufficient for one task while losing information needed for another.

cross_view_translation.meaning: A claimed inner↔outer or micro↔macro relation gains mathematical content only when one view predicts or reconstructs another better than baseline.

commutative_diagram_test.interpretation: If two representational routes claim to preserve the same structure, their disagreement is directly measurable. Approximate commutation can replace vague statements that two symbolic systems 'line up'.

reconstruction.bayesian: p(X|Y_1,...,Y_m) proportional to p(X) product_k p(Y_k|X) under conditional-independence assumptions
reconstruction.ambiguity: If pi_k is many-to-one, a view determines a fiber of possible hidden states rather than a unique X.

invariants.condition: I_a(X)=I_a'(pi_k(X)) for a declared invariant/derived statistic
invariants.cross_view: I_j(Y_j) approximately I_k(Y_k) only after the two statistics are proven to represent the same abstract quantity
invariants.failure: Numerical similarity is not an invariant if the variables have different dimensions, sampling processes or semantics.

dimensional_collapse_taxonomy.project_scaffold: Sun/Spudlight and M-theory above; Earth/Midgard 4D; Saturn/box 3D; Moon/frame 2D; dust/speck 1D; Door at 5D.
dimensional_collapse_taxonomy.safe_interpretation: Treat d mainly as description/relational-complexity index unless a physical spacetime calculation separately defines d.
dimensional_collapse_taxonomy.round_trip: R_(d-1)(F_d(x)) generally != x because reduction can be lossy
dimensional_collapse_taxonomy.meaning: Descent/compression can remove distinctions; ascent/reconstruction requires priors or side information to restore them.

phase_cross_geometry.horizontal_vertical: Represent deliberately orthogonal coordinates h,v with <h,v>=0 only when they belong to a common inner-product space.
phase_cross_geometry.quarter_turn: R(pi/2)=[[0,-1],[1,0]] in a two-dimensional Euclidean plane
phase_cross_geometry.spiral_extension: A spiral or helix adds evolution/scale change; a static cross or vesica alone does not imply dynamics.
phase_cross_geometry.boundary: A project Father/Son 90-degree relation is a chosen formal geometry unless independently derived from data.

historical_project_examples: inner neurological center ↔ outer cosmic center
macro_micro_comparison.scientific_test: Compare dimensionless, explicitly defined descriptors or functional network roles—not raw visual resemblance.
macro_micro_comparison.nulls: Use matched random structures or same-domain alternative mappings to estimate how often similar motifs occur by chance.
macro_micro_comparison.boundary: Morphological or functional analogy does not establish dynamical coupling between brain and cosmic structures.

category_theoretic_neighbor.objects: Domain-specific descriptions can be objects/categories with typed morphisms preserving selected structure.
category_theoretic_neighbor.functor_question: Does a proposed translation preserve composition/identity of the structures it claims to map?
category_theoretic_neighbor.natural_transformation_neighbor: Door can be compared to a transformation between projection/translation schemes when the categorical objects are actually specified.
category_theoretic_neighbor.warning: Category theory should expose type errors and compositional structure, not decorate arbitrary analogy.

baselines: independent views with no shared latent state
model_comparison_contract.success: The Mirror model earns value if a shared representation predicts views/tasks better than independent descriptions while preserving type boundaries and calibrated uncertainty.

failure_conditions: Cross-view mappings work only after hand-selecting correspondences from the target data.
A shared latent model performs no better than independent baselines.
The proposed invariant changes when equivalent measurement units or coordinate conventions are changed.
Symbolic project coordinates are silently treated as physical spacetime dimensions.
Mappings collapse distinct causal mechanisms merely because their diagrams look similar.
